items.name: Mixed salad greens (arugula-type leaves)
items.preparation: raw, uncooked leaves, loosely tossed in a bowl with no visible dressing

items.name: Shredded carrot
items.preparation: raw, julienned or shredded into thin strips and scattered through the greens

scale_cues: White square bowl about 22-25 cm across used as the reference. The greens fill roughly the central third of the bowl, about 10-12 cm across. Carrot strips are about 3-5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, consistent with a small garnish.
assumptions: Leaves are arugula-type based on lobed, peppery-looking shape; the exact green could be a mesclun mix.
No dressing, oil or cheese is clearly visible, so none is listed; a light dressing sheen could add a few grams.
Leaf mass estimated from the apparent volume and typical leaf density of loose raw greens.
Carrot is above the 5 g merge threshold in the best estimate, so it is kept separate.
